title: carex petricosa var. franklinii

It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which may include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Franklin's sedge include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe irritated skin, and alleviate respiratory issues.
